pairs.description: Feverfew contains sesquiterpene lactones that inhibit platelet aggregation, heightening bleeding hazards when taken alongside warfarin.
pairs.mechanism: Inhibition of platelet granule secretion and thromboxane B2 formation by parthenolide.

pairs.description: Combining feverfew and aspirin produces additive platelet antiaggregatory activity, increasing bruising and bleeding time.
pairs.mechanism: Complementary suppression of platelet cyclooxygenase activity and platelet secretion mechanisms.

pairs.description: Concomitant administration of feverfew and nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs may exacerbate gastric mucosal irritation and bleeding.
pairs.mechanism: Dual inhibition of platelet aggregation and gastric mucosal barrier prostaglandin synthesis.
